title: Practice tab: choose the page structure
question: All three keep the app's look (cream, terracotta, the tab bar) and lead with your latest result and weak topics. They differ in what carries the page. Lock one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Progress scorecard
options.lineage: a school report card that also shows last term
options.thesis: Your latest strength %, big, with a dot for every earlier test beside it, so you see at once if you're improving.
options.viewport: Top: 'Motion in a Plane' · 37% strength at display size, a row of dots for earlier tests and '+12 since last'. Then the 3 weakest topics as bars with their strength. Then 'Retake weak topics' (filled) beside 'New test'.
options.risk: With only one test so far, the trend row is a single dot and needs a good 'take another to see your trend' state.

options.label: OMR answer sheet
options.lineage: the JEE/NEET OMR bubble sheet every student has filled
options.thesis: Your last test drawn as its answer sheet: one numbered bubble per question, ticked right, crossed wrong, hollow skipped.
options.viewport: Top: test name and 11/30 right · 37%. Under it the bubble grid (Q1–Q30), each bubble carrying ✓ or ✗ so it reads without colour. Then weak topics with 'Retake weak topics' and 'New test'.
options.risk: Needs the full answer data for the latest test (one extra request), and a 90-question test makes a tall grid that has to wrap cleanly.

options.label: Subject shelves
options.lineage: a study planner with a page per subject
options.thesis: Latest result on top, then one shelf per subject: its last strength, its weak topics as chips, and 'Test' / 'Practise' right there.
options.viewport: Top: latest result card (37%, weakest 3 topics, 'Retake weak topics'). Below, a Physics shelf: 'Last test 37%', chips for 'Vectors' and 'Projectile motion', buttons 'Test Physics' and 'Practise chapters'. Then Chemistry, then Maths.
options.risk: Topic practice moves inside each subject shelf instead of its own list, and subjects with no tests yet need an inviting empty shelf.
